texts.guidance.gate.under18: Rafiq is for adults. Talk to a parent or guardian, a doctor or a school nurse. If you have sudden severe pain, call emergency services now.
texts.guidance.p0.emergency: This may need urgent treatment in hospital. Call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now.
texts.guidance.p0.dont_drive: Do not drive yourself. Ask someone to take you or call an ambulance.
texts.guidance.p0.bring_meds: If you can, bring a list of the medicines you take.
texts.guidance.p1.fever_same_day: A medical assessment today is recommended. If the pain suddenly becomes severe, or you start vomiting or feeling sick, call emergency services.
texts.guidance.p2.fever_unsure: If you find that you do have a fever with the pain or swelling, get a medical assessment today.
texts.guidance.safe006.emergency_criteria: You weren't sure about one of the warning-sign questions. If any of these apply to you — sudden severe pain, pain with nausea, vomiting or tummy pain, or pain lasting more than an hour or while resting — call emergency services now. Otherwise, a medical assessment today is recommended.
texts.guidance.p2.lump_exam: Book an appointment soon with a doctor for an in-person examination. Most lumps have causes that are not serious, but an examination is the only way to find out. Please don't try to work it out yourself.
texts.guidance.p3.lump_self_check: Learning how to check your testicles can help you notice changes. If you notice a lump or a change, see a doctor.
texts.guidance.p3.chronic: Some long-term conditions can be linked to reproductive and sexual health. Talk about this with the doctor who looks after you, especially if you are planning a family.
texts.guidance.p3.repro_history: Tell your doctor about this history. If you had an undescended testicle, it can help to learn how to check yourself.
texts.guidance.steroids: These substances can affect sperm production. Talk to a doctor about your use — and don't change any prescribed treatment without their advice.
texts.guidance.p2.chemo_planned: Before treatment starts, ask your care team about options for preserving fertility, such as freezing sperm. It is best to discuss this early.
texts.guidance.chemo_past: Let your doctor know about your past treatment when you discuss your reproductive health.
texts.guidance.p3.medication_list: Some medicines can affect reproductive health. Bring a list of your medicines to your doctor, and don't stop any medicine without their advice.
texts.guidance.p3.smoking: Smoking is linked to harmful effects on reproductive health. Your doctor or a stop-smoking service can help you quit.
texts.guidance.p3.occupational: Some workplace exposures can affect reproductive health. Talk about protective measures with your doctor or your workplace safety officer.
texts.guidance.p2.sexual_urinary: These symptoms are common and many of their causes can be treated. Book an appointment with a doctor to talk about them.
texts.guidance.p3.family_history: Tell your doctor about this family history. It may help them decide whether any follow-up or tests are needed.
texts.guidance.p2.trying_12m: After 12 months of regular trying without a pregnancy, a medical assessment for both partners is usually recommended. This is a routine step and does not necessarily mean there is a problem.
texts.guidance.p2.trying_6_12m_partner_35: When the female partner is 35 or older, an earlier assessment for both partners may be recommended. Talk to a doctor.
texts.guidance.p2.previous_abnormal: Follow up with the doctor who ordered the test. Rafiq does not interpret test results.
texts.guidance.p3.previous_unsure: Take the report with you to your doctor.

texts.guidance.p3.lifestyle: Everyday habits can affect reproductive health. Steps you can start at home: avoid long hot baths, saunas and a laptop on your lap; move a little every day; aim for regular sleep; and cut down or stop alcohol. Small changes count.
texts.guidance.p3.lifestyle_doctor: A doctor or your primary care team can support you with weight or substance use privately and without judgement.
